name: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc.
summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc., an independent energy company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, exploitation, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas properties in the United States. The company primarily holds interests in the Bakken and Three Forks formations in the Williston Basin of North Dakota and Montana. As of December 31, 2020, it owned working interests in 6,640 gross producing wells; and had proved reserves of 122,632 million barrels of oil equivalent. The company is based in Minnetonka, Minnesota.
